title: Noonan Syndrome in Thai Children.
abstract: This study describes clinical features of Noonan syndrome and gene mutations, including PTPN11, SOS1, and BRAF in the Thai population.Widely spaced eyes were the most common finding from the digital facial analysis technology used in this study.
